text:
[Council File 26-1560; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and ADMINISTRATIVE EXEMPTION relative to five- year agreements with Integrated Engineering Management (IEM), CPM Partners, Inc., WSP USA Inc., Psomas, and Arcadis U.S., Inc., for 2026-2031 on-call construction consultant management services at the Port of Los Angeles.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. CONCUR with the determination by the Board of Harbor Commissioners that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE Port of Los Angeles Resolution No. 26-10802 authorizing five-year agreements with Integrated Engineering Management (IEM), Agreement No. 26-10274; CPM Partners, Inc., Agreement No. 26-10275; WSP USA Inc., Agreement No. 26-10276; Psomas, Agreement No. 26-10277; and Arcadis U.S., Inc., Agreement No. 26-10278, for on-call construction consultant management services at the Port of Los Angeles, in an amount not to exceed $5,000,000 per agreement, for a combined total not to exceed $25,000,000.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board of Harbor Commissioners reports that approval of the proposed agreements will authorize a total amount of $25,000,000 over a five-year period. Fiscal Year 2026-27 funding in the amount of $2,500,000 is available in Account 161305 (Construction in Progress), Division 00000 (Harbor Global). The Harbor Department is financially responsible for expenses incurred under the agreements. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - DECEMBER 26, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - DECEMBER 15, 2026
